articles.title: Cloudy Wednesday for Hyderabad; rain recorded in few parts of Rangareddy, Sangareddy
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: People who stepped out of homes in Hyderabad on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) have observed the sky to be cloudy. The change in weather conditions was observed a day after Telangana districts stretching from eastern to southern part received heavy to light rain.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: But the city did not receive rain until noon on Wednesday at least. Very light rain was recorded in a few parts of Rangareddy, Sangareddy and Nalgonda. According to Telangana Development Planning Society’s weather observations till 11 a.m., 3.8 mm rain was recorded in Kamkole of Sangareddy and Gunegal of Rangareddy. India Meteorological Department-Hyderabad Centre has forecast a generally cloudy sky turning partly cloudy towards evening or night. It did not predict the city to receive rain on Wednesday.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: There was no change in the temperatures recorded. The lowest of 15.6°C was recorded in Kumaram Bheem Asifabad, followed by 16.0°C in Adilabad and 16.4°C in Wanaparthy. While the lowest temperature of 20.1°C was recorded in Rangareddy, it was 20.4°C in Medchal Malkajgiri and 22.5°C in Hyderabad.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Cloudy Wednesday for Hyderabad; rain recorded in few parts of Rangareddy, Sangareddy

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 12:13:54 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: People who stepped out of homes in Hyderabad on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) have observed the sky to be cloudy. The change in weather conditions was observed a day after Telangana districts stretching from eastern to southern part received heavy to light rain.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: But the city did not receive rain until noon on Wednesday at least. Very light rain was recorded in a few parts of Rangareddy, Sangareddy and Nalgonda. According to Telangana Development Planning Society’s weather observations till 11 a.m., 3.8 mm rain was recorded in Kamkole of Sangareddy and Gunegal of Rangareddy. India Meteorological Department-Hyderabad Centre has forecast a generally cloudy sky turning partly cloudy towards evening or night. It did not predict the city to receive rain on Wednesday.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: There was no change in the temperatures recorded. The lowest of 15.6°C was recorded in Kumaram Bheem Asifabad, followed by 16.0°C in Adilabad and 16.4°C in Wanaparthy. While the lowest temperature of 20.1°C was recorded in Rangareddy, it was 20.4°C in Medchal Malkajgiri and 22.5°C in Hyderabad.

articles.title: Thirupparankundram ‘deepathoon’ row LIVE: TVK government accused of defying Supreme Court order
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Devotees barred from Tirupparankundram hill for the second consecutive day and heavy security deployed

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The district administration, in a statement released yesterday, said that all arrangements were made as directed by the Supreme Court. The temple Devasthanam was requested and instructed in writing and reminded to authorise its team and proceed. However, the Devasthanam did not authorise a team until the last moment. Instead, its Board of Trustees passed a resolution to light the lamp at the usual place, and the lamp was lit at the Deepa Mandapam, said in the statement from temple officials. Shortly after the Karthigaideepam was lit at the usual place atop Thirupparankundram yesterday, the Arulmighu Subramanian Swamy Temple Executive Officer G. Selvi and Board of Trustees chairman V. Shanmugasundaram jointly stated in a press release that the temple has followed the age-old culture and agama rules in lighting the lamp. The Board of Trustees, including C. Rajapandian, K. Alagappan, K. Regina Devi and K. Chitra, who were present, passed a resolution unanimously. The members resolved to follow the rituals and ensure that the festival was conducted in a peaceful environment. The press release said the temple, which is famous and the first abode of Lord Muruga (Arupadai Veedu), has been following the rituals from time immemorial. The temple, which has been conducting various festivals all through the year, adopted custom and rituals and age-old continued practices as per the agama rules. The Supreme Court on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) said it will hear the contempt plea and peruse the status report of the Tamil Nadu government over the issue of non-lighting of the traditional Karthigai Deepam lamp at Deepathoon atop the Thiruparankundram hill in Madurai district. Devotees and the general public were barred from ascending the Tirupparankundram hill here for the second consecutive day on Wednesday (November 25, 2026), with heavy police personnel deployed near the entrance of the Palani Andavar temple. Police have erected barricades along the pathway leading to the hill and are restricting entry strictly to local residents. Those living on Kottai Street, which leads to the Palani Andavar temple, are being permitted access only after verification of their address through Aadhaar cards. Heavy police deployment continued near the Palani Andavar temple entrance on Wednesday (November 24, 2026), as the restrictions remained in place.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The petitioners have accused the Tamil Nadu government of defying the Supreme Court order on lighting the Karthigai Deepam lamp in Madurai’s Thirupparankundram.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Thirupparankundram ‘deepathoon’ row LIVE: TVK government accused of defying Supreme Court order

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 12:10:24 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Devotees barred from Tirupparankundram hill for the second consecutive day and heavy security deployed

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The district administration, in a statement released yesterday, said that all arrangements were made as directed by the Supreme Court. The temple Devasthanam was requested and instructed in writing and reminded to authorise its team and proceed. However, the Devasthanam did not authorise a team until the last moment. Instead, its Board of Trustees passed a resolution to light the lamp at the usual place, and the lamp was lit at the Deepa Mandapam, said in the statement from temple officials. Shortly after the Karthigaideepam was lit at the usual place atop Thirupparankundram yesterday, the Arulmighu Subramanian Swamy Temple Executive Officer G. Selvi and Board of Trustees chairman V. Shanmugasundaram jointly stated in a press release that the temple has followed the age-old culture and agama rules in lighting the lamp. The Board of Trustees, including C. Rajapandian, K. Alagappan, K. Regina Devi and K. Chitra, who were present, passed a resolution unanimously. The members resolved to follow the rituals and ensure that the festival was conducted in a peaceful environment. The press release said the temple, which is famous and the first abode of Lord Muruga (Arupadai Veedu), has been following the rituals from time immemorial. The temple, which has been conducting various festivals all through the year, adopted custom and rituals and age-old continued practices as per the agama rules. The Supreme Court on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) said it will hear the contempt plea and peruse the status report of the Tamil Nadu government over the issue of non-lighting of the traditional Karthigai Deepam lamp at Deepathoon atop the Thiruparankundram hill in Madurai district. Devotees and the general public were barred from ascending the Tirupparankundram hill here for the second consecutive day on Wednesday (November 25, 2026), with heavy police personnel deployed near the entrance of the Palani Andavar temple. Police have erected barricades along the pathway leading to the hill and are restricting entry strictly to local residents. Those living on Kottai Street, which leads to the Palani Andavar temple, are being permitted access only after verification of their address through Aadhaar cards. Heavy police deployment continued near the Palani Andavar temple entrance on Wednesday (November 24, 2026), as the restrictions remained in place.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The petitioners have accused the Tamil Nadu government of defying the Supreme Court order on lighting the Karthigai Deepam lamp in Madurai’s Thirupparankundram.

Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic
Administration (Noun)
प्रशासन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Administration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Verification (Noun)
सत्यापन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Verification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Consecutive (Adjective)
लगातार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consecutive' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Thirupparankundram ‘deepathoon’ row LIVE: TVK government accused of defying Supreme Court order", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Devotees barred from Tirupparankundram hill for the second consecutive day and heavy security deployed.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Thirupparankundram ‘deepathoon’ row LIVE: TVK go' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Thirupparankundram ‘deepathoon’ row LIVE: TVK' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Thirupparankundram ‘deepathoon’ row LIVE: TVK' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Devotees barred from Tirupparankundram hill for the second consecutive day and heavy security deployed." (Hinglish Arth: श्रद्धालुओं को लगातार दूसरे दिन तिरुप्परनकुंद्रम पहाड़ी पर जाने से रोका गया और भारी सुरक्षा तैनात की गई)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Thirupparankundram ‘deepathoon’ row LIVE: TVK government accused of defying Supreme Court order"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The petitioners have accused the Tamil Nadu government of defying the Supreme Court order on lighting the Karthigai Deepam lamp in Madurai’s...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The petitioners have accused the Tamil Nadu government of defying the Supreme Court order on lighting the Karthigai Deepam lamp in Madurai’s..." (Hinglish Arth: याचिकाकर्ताओं ने तमिलनाडु सरकार पर मदुरै के थिरुप्पारनकुंड्रम में कार्तिगई दीपम दीपक जलाने पर सुप्रीम कोर्ट के आदेश की अवहेलना करने का आरोप लगाया है।)

articles.title: U.P. Assembly polls: Congress’ Imran Masood slams SP over seat-sharing, says ‘we aren’t begging’
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The first round of talks that ended at Congress veteran Pramod Tiwari's Delhi residence remained inconclusive, with SP revealing its initial offer of 26 seats, way lower than Congress’s expectations

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Congress Uttar Pradesh Working Committee chief Imran Masood on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) lashed out at the SP, saying, “We aren’t begging,” after the latter announced candidates for five seats ahead of the upcoming Assembly polls even as the seat-sharing talks are underway. His retort came as the Samajwadi Party (SP) has named a candidate in Saharanpur — in Masood’s Lok Sabha constituency. The Congress leader said he will discuss with the party leadership whether seat-sharing talks with the SP should continue. He said, “When you are holding talks on one hand and making announcements on the other, it shows that you are not serious." "We will discuss within our party what needs to be done and whether we should sit for talks or not. The party will decide what course of action to take," he told PTI Videos . The first round of talks that ended on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) at Congress veteran Pramod Tiwari's Delhi residence remained inconclusive, with SP revealing its initial offer of 26 seats, way lower than Congress’s expectations. Questioning the intention of their ally, Mr. Masood said, "I do not understand whether you want to fight me, the Congress or the BJP. It needs to be decided whether we want to fight the BJP or fight among ourselves." Of the five seats that the SP declared candidates for in a surprise move, four are held by its sitting MLAs — Ashu Malik from Saharanpur, Nahid Hasan from Kairana, Umar Ali Khan from Behat and Mehboob Ali from Amroha. The four seats are in western Uttar Pradesh, where the SP expects a challenge from BJP, its ally RLD, as well as the recently floated Samajik Parivartan Morcha of AIMIM leader Asaduddin Owaisi and Aazad Samaj Party (Kanshi Ram) chief Chandrashekar Aazad. Its fifth candidate is Jyoti Lodhi, who will contest from Lalitpur in Bundelkhand. On differences within the INDIA bloc, Mr. Masood said he could not comment on the internal matters of other parties. "Everyone has their own views. We are making honest efforts, but I cannot say what is going on in the minds of others," he said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Later, he told PTI while talking about seat-sharing, "We aren't begging. The deal has to be mutually acceptable, respectable."

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 U.P. Assembly polls: Congress’ Imran Masood slams SP over seat-sharing, says ‘we aren’t begging’

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 12:08:43 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The first round of talks that ended at Congress veteran Pramod Tiwari's Delhi residence remained inconclusive, with SP revealing its initial offer of 26 seats, way lower than Congress’s expectations

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Congress Uttar Pradesh Working Committee chief Imran Masood on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) lashed out at the SP, saying, “We aren’t begging,” after the latter announced candidates for five seats ahead of the upcoming Assembly polls even as the seat-sharing talks are underway. His retort came as the Samajwadi Party (SP) has named a candidate in Saharanpur — in Masood’s Lok Sabha constituency. The Congress leader said he will discuss with the party leadership whether seat-sharing talks with the SP should continue. He said, “When you are holding talks on one hand and making announcements on the other, it shows that you are not serious." "We will discuss within our party what needs to be done and whether we should sit for talks or not. The party will decide what course of action to take," he told PTI Videos . The first round of talks that ended on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) at Congress veteran Pramod Tiwari's Delhi residence remained inconclusive, with SP revealing its initial offer of 26 seats, way lower than Congress’s expectations. Questioning the intention of their ally, Mr. Masood said, "I do not understand whether you want to fight me, the Congress or the BJP. It needs to be decided whether we want to fight the BJP or fight among ourselves." Of the five seats that the SP declared candidates for in a surprise move, four are held by its sitting MLAs — Ashu Malik from Saharanpur, Nahid Hasan from Kairana, Umar Ali Khan from Behat and Mehboob Ali from Amroha. The four seats are in western Uttar Pradesh, where the SP expects a challenge from BJP, its ally RLD, as well as the recently floated Samajik Parivartan Morcha of AIMIM leader Asaduddin Owaisi and Aazad Samaj Party (Kanshi Ram) chief Chandrashekar Aazad. Its fifth candidate is Jyoti Lodhi, who will contest from Lalitpur in Bundelkhand. On differences within the INDIA bloc, Mr. Masood said he could not comment on the internal matters of other parties. "Everyone has their own views. We are making honest efforts, but I cannot say what is going on in the minds of others," he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Later, he told PTI while talking about seat-sharing, "We aren't begging. The deal has to be mutually acceptable, respectable."

दुविधा में पड़ा हुआ — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Inconclusive' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The first round of talks that ended at Congress veteran Pramod Tiwari's Delhi residence remained inconclusive, with SP revealing its initial offer of 26 seats, way lower than Congress’s expectations
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Congress Uttar Pradesh Working Committee chief Imran Masood on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) lashed out at the SP, saying, “We aren’t begging,” after the latter announced candidates for five seats ahead of the upcoming Assembly polls even as the seat-sharing talks are underway. His retort came as the Samajwadi Party (SP) has named a candidate in Saharanpur — in Masood’s Lok Sabha constituency. The Congress leader said he will discuss with the party leadership whether seat-sharing talks with the SP should continue. He said, “When you are holding talks on one hand and making announcements on the other, it shows that you are not serious." "We will discuss within our party what needs to be done and whether we should sit for talks or not. The party will decide what course of action to take," he told PTI Videos . The first round of talks that ended on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) at Congress veteran Pramod Tiwari's Delhi residence remained inconclusive, with SP revealing its initial offer of 26 seats, way lower than Congress’s expectations. Questioning the intention of their ally, Mr. Masood said, "I do not understand whether you want to fight me, the Congress or the BJP. It needs to be decided whether we want to fight the BJP or fight among ourselves." Of the five seats that the SP declared candidates for in a surprise move, four are held by its sitting MLAs — Ashu Malik from Saharanpur, Nahid Hasan from Kairana, Umar Ali Khan from Behat and Mehboob Ali from Amroha. The four seats are in western Uttar Pradesh, where the SP expects a challenge from BJP, its ally RLD, as well as the recently floated Samajik Parivartan Morcha of AIMIM leader Asaduddin Owaisi and Aazad Samaj Party (Kanshi Ram) chief Chandrashekar Aazad. Its fifth candidate is Jyoti Lodhi, who will contest from Lalitpur in Bundelkhand. On differences within the INDIA bloc, Mr. Masood said he could not comment on the internal matters of other parties. "Everyone has their own views. We are making honest efforts, but I cannot say what is going on in the minds of others," he said.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Later, he told PTI while talking about seat-sharing, "We aren't begging. The deal has to be mutually acceptable, respectable."

articles.title: Woman gang-raped by colleagues at east Delhi cafe; three arrested
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Two women are among those held so far, while three others remain absconding; the victim and her colleagues had allegedly consumed alcohol at two locations in a late-night gathering before the incident

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A 22-year-old woman was gang-raped allegedly by two male colleagues during a late-night gathering at a cafe in east Delhi’s Preet Vihar in the early hours of Tuesday (November 24, 2026). The police arrested three people, including two women, in connection with the case. Three other accused are on the run and efforts are under way to trace them, Deputy Commissioner of Police (East) Rajeev Kumar said. According to the officer, the woman and the six accused worked at another cafe in a mall near Karkardooma Court. All six persons are Delhi residents who worked as attendants and waiters at the cafe. After their workplace shut on Monday night (November 23, 2026), the group decided to party and first consumed alcohol before heading to the residence of one of the colleagues in Mandawali, where they allegedly consumed more alcohol. The "party” continued into the early hours of Tuesday (November 24, 2026). At around 2.30 a.m., they returned to Preet Vihar and went to Saltanate Cafe, which had shut for the night at around 11.30 p.m. “One of the men had previously worked at the establishment and was aware about where the keys were kept. He contacted its caretaker to confirm the location of the keys. The group then gained access to the cafe and continued drinking,” Mr. Kumar added. Around 3.30 a.m., the three women left with a male friend of the victim, who had arrived to pick her up. The men left for their respective homes, as per the CCTV footage checked by the police. At around 6 a.m., the victim, accompanied by her male friend, approached the police and alleged that two of her male colleagues had sexually assaulted her during the gathering and that the group had assisted them in the crime.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A case was then registered under the relevant provisions relating to gang rape.

📰 Woman gang-raped by colleagues at east Delhi cafe; three arrested

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 12:08:37 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Two women are among those held so far, while three others remain absconding; the victim and her colleagues had allegedly consumed alcohol at two locations in a late-night gathering before the incident

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A 22-year-old woman was gang-raped allegedly by two male colleagues during a late-night gathering at a cafe in east Delhi’s Preet Vihar in the early hours of Tuesday (November 24, 2026). The police arrested three people, including two women, in connection with the case. Three other accused are on the run and efforts are under way to trace them, Deputy Commissioner of Police (East) Rajeev Kumar said. According to the officer, the woman and the six accused worked at another cafe in a mall near Karkardooma Court. All six persons are Delhi residents who worked as attendants and waiters at the cafe. After their workplace shut on Monday night (November 23, 2026), the group decided to party and first consumed alcohol before heading to the residence of one of the colleagues in Mandawali, where they allegedly consumed more alcohol. The "party” continued into the early hours of Tuesday (November 24, 2026). At around 2.30 a.m., they returned to Preet Vihar and went to Saltanate Cafe, which had shut for the night at around 11.30 p.m. “One of the men had previously worked at the establishment and was aware about where the keys were kept. He contacted its caretaker to confirm the location of the keys. The group then gained access to the cafe and continued drinking,” Mr. Kumar added. Around 3.30 a.m., the three women left with a male friend of the victim, who had arrived to pick her up. The men left for their respective homes, as per the CCTV footage checked by the police. At around 6 a.m., the victim, accompanied by her male friend, approached the police and alleged that two of her male colleagues had sexually assaulted her during the gathering and that the group had assisted them in the crime.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A case was then registered under the relevant provisions relating to gang rape.

articles.title: Global climate talks must shut door on fossil fuel ‘clout’
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The breakdown in the Antalya summit has deepened the crisis of confidence in climate diplomacy, making transparency and accountability in the negotiating process more urgent than ever.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The failure of the United Nations climate summit in Antalya, Türkiye, to agree on its central political statement, with countries unable to bridge their differences over fossil fuels and other key questions of climate action, has exposed the fragility of international climate cooperation. It should also sharpen scrutiny of who gets access to climate negotiations, whose interests they represent and what safeguards keep decisions accountable to the public. The Türkiye summit ended without agreement on an overarching statement. UN climate chief Simon Stiell said he shared the “deep disappointment” of many that the conference was unable to reach consensus on a statement that typically sends a policy signal to all nations. Some separate negotiating decisions were reached though. Nevertheless, the absence of a political consensus was a serious setback. The breakdown does not show that fossil fuel lobbying caused the impasse. But it does make more urgent a separate question about the credibility of the process. A forum that asks governments to make decisions in the global public interest must be transparent about who is seeking to shape those decisions, what interests they represent and how conflicts are managed. The international climate negotiations that take place every year still lack a comprehensive, enforceable system to identify and manage conflicts of interest involving powerful commercial interests, including fossil fuel companies and state-owned energy businesses. The Antalya conference has underlined why that gap matters. The fossil fuel industry’s record of muddying the waters is well documented. A 2017 study by Geoffrey Supran and Naomi Oreskes compared 187 ExxonMobil communications between 1977 and 2014, including internal documents, scientific publications and paid newspaper advertorials. It found that as the company’s communications became more public, they increasingly expressed doubt about climate science. The researchers concluded that ExxonMobil had contributed to climate science while promoting doubt about it in its advertorials. An industry team discussed a 1998 draft of the Global Climate Science Communications Plan at the American Petroleum Institute’s headquarters. The plan’s stated goal was to persuade a majority of the American public that significant uncertainties remained in climate science and to raise questions among policymakers. This history matters because companies with large investments in oil, gas and coal have a financial stake in how quickly those fuels are phased down, which technologies receive support and how the costs of the transition are distributed. That does not mean every company representative at a climate summit is there to obstruct progress, or that attendance proves influence over a decision. It, however, does mean commercial interests need to be visible and the process needs rules to prevent undue influence. The scale of corporate participation in Antalya brings the issue into sharper focus. An analysis by a coalition of non-profits identified 103 major polluter groups with delegations at the summit, including fossil fuel businesses, financiers and companies from other high-emitting sectors. It also identified 30 banks whose fossil fuel financing between 2021 and 2025 amounted to more than $2.2 trillion. These are the coalition’s classifications, not official UN figures. They do not establish that the companies or banks influenced the negotiations. But they show the scale of commercial interests present at a conference whose purpose is to limit global warming.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Lien Vandamme of the Center for International Environmental Law says the problem goes beyond the number of corporate participants. Although the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) has introduced limited disclosure requirements, she argues that it still lacks a policy to curb corporate influence. “There is currently no policy to curb corporate influence within the UNFCCC process, and this is a fundamental problem,” she says. Once companies gain access, she argues, it becomes extremely difficult to monitor how they use it to influence negotiations.

hinglishTracks.en: It should also sharpen scrutiny of who gets access to climate negotiations, whose interests they represent and what safeguards keep decisions accountable to the public.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इसे इस बात की भी जांच तेज करनी चाहिए कि जलवायु वार्ताओं तक किसे पहुंच मिलती है, वे किसके हितों का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं और कौन से सुरक्षा उपाय निर्णयों को जनता के प्रति जवाबदेह बनाए रखते हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: The Türkiye summit ended without agreement on an overarching statement.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — तुर्किये शिखर सम्मेलन एक व्यापक बयान पर सहमति के बिना समाप्त हो गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: UN climate chief Simon Stiell said he shared the “deep disappointment” of many that the conference was unable to reach consensus on a statement that typically sends a policy signal to all nations.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — संयुक्त राष्ट्र के जलवायु प्रमुख साइमन स्टिल ने कहा कि वह कई लोगों की "गहरी निराशा" को साझा करते हैं कि सम्मेलन एक ऐसे बयान पर आम सहमति तक पहुंचने में असमर्थ था जो आम तौर पर सभी देशों को नीति संकेत भेजता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Some separate negotiating decisions were reached though.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हालाँकि कुछ अलग-अलग बातचीत के निर्णयों पर सहमति बनी।।

hinglishTracks.en: Nevertheless, the absence of a political consensus was a serious setback.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — फिर भी, राजनीतिक सहमति का अभाव एक गंभीर झटका था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The breakdown does not show that fossil fuel lobbying caused the impasse.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — ब्रेकडाउन से यह नहीं पता चलता कि जीवाश्म ईंधन की पैरवी गतिरोध का कारण बनी।।

hinglishTracks.en: But it does make more urgent a separate question about the credibility of the process.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — लेकिन यह प्रक्रिया की विश्वसनीयता के बारे में एक अलग प्रश्न को और अधिक जरूरी बना देता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: A forum that asks governments to make decisions in the global public interest must be transparent about who is seeking to shape those decisions, what interests they represent and how conflicts are managed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — एक मंच जो सरकारों से वैश्विक जनहित में निर्णय लेने के लिए कहता है, उसे इस बारे में पारदर्शी होना चाहिए कि उन निर्णयों को कौन आकार देना चाहता है, वे किन हितों का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं और संघर्षों का प्रबंधन कैसे किया जाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The international climate negotiations that take place every year still lack a comprehensive, enforceable system to identify and manage conflicts of interest involving powerful commercial interests, including fossil fuel companies and state-owned energy businesses.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हर साल होने वाली अंतर्राष्ट्रीय जलवायु वार्ता में अभी भी जीवाश्म ईंधन कंपनियों और राज्य के स्वामित्व वाले ऊर्जा व्यवसायों सहित शक्तिशाली वाणिज्यिक हितों से जुड़े हितों के टकराव की पहचान करने और प्रबंधित करने के लिए एक व्यापक, लागू करने योग्य प्रणाली का अभाव है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Enforcement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Implementation, Execution, Administration और Antonyms हैं: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver।

hinglishTracks.en: The Antalya conference has underlined why that gap matters.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अंताल्या सम्मेलन ने रेखांकित किया है कि यह अंतर क्यों मायने रखता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The fossil fuel industry’s record of muddying the waters is well documented.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — जीवाश्म ईंधन उद्योग का पानी को गंदा करने का रिकॉर्ड अच्छी तरह से प्रलेखित है।।

hinglishTracks.en: A 2017 study by Geoffrey Supran and Naomi Oreskes compared 187 ExxonMobil communications between 1977 and 2014, including internal documents, scientific publications and paid newspaper advertorials.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — जेफ्री सुप्रान और नाओमी ओरेस्केस द्वारा 2017 के एक अध्ययन में 1977 और 2014 के बीच 187 एक्सॉनमोबिल संचार की तुलना की गई, जिसमें आंतरिक दस्तावेज़, वैज्ञानिक प्रकाशन और भुगतान किए गए समाचार पत्र विज्ञापन शामिल हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: It found that as the company’s communications became more public, they increasingly expressed doubt about climate science.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इसमें पाया गया कि जैसे-जैसे कंपनी के संचार अधिक सार्वजनिक होते गए, उन्होंने जलवायु विज्ञान के बारे में संदेह व्यक्त करना शुरू कर दिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: The researchers concluded that ExxonMobil had contributed to climate science while promoting doubt about it in its advertorials.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — शोधकर्ताओं ने निष्कर्ष निकाला कि एक्सॉनमोबिल ने अपने विज्ञापनों में इसके बारे में संदेह को बढ़ावा देते हुए जलवायु विज्ञान में योगदान दिया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: An industry team discussed a 1998 draft of the Global Climate Science Communications Plan at the American Petroleum Institute’s headquarters.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — एक उद्योग दल ने अमेरिकी पेट्रोलियम संस्थान के मुख्यालय में वैश्विक जलवायु विज्ञान संचार योजना के 1998 के मसौदे पर चर्चा की।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Institutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ। इसके Synonyms हैं: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional और Antonyms हैं: Individual, Informal, Unorganized।

hinglishTracks.en: The plan’s stated goal was to persuade a majority of the American public that significant uncertainties remained in climate science and to raise questions among policymakers.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — योजना का घोषित लक्ष्य अमेरिकी जनता के बहुमत को यह विश्वास दिलाना था कि जलवायु विज्ञान में महत्वपूर्ण अनिश्चितताएँ बनी हुई हैं और नीति निर्माताओं के बीच सवाल खड़े करना था।।

hinglishTracks.en: This history matters because companies with large investments in oil, gas and coal have a financial stake in how quickly those fuels are phased down, which technologies receive support and how the costs of the transition are distributed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यह इतिहास मायने रखता है क्योंकि तेल, गैस और कोयले में बड़े निवेश वाली कंपनियों की वित्तीय हिस्सेदारी होती है कि कितनी जल्दी उन ईंधनों को चरणबद्ध तरीके से बंद किया जाता है, किन प्रौद्योगिकियों को समर्थन मिलता है और संक्रमण की लागत कैसे वितरित की जाती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: That does not mean every company representative at a climate summit is there to obstruct progress, or that attendance proves influence over a decision.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इसका मतलब यह नहीं है कि जलवायु शिखर सम्मेलन में प्रत्येक कंपनी का प्रतिनिधि प्रगति में बाधा डालने के लिए मौजूद है, या यह कि उपस्थिति किसी निर्णय पर प्रभाव साबित करती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It, however, does mean commercial interests need to be visible and the process needs rules to prevent undue influence.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हालाँकि, इसका मतलब यह है कि व्यावसायिक हितों को दिखाई देने की आवश्यकता है और प्रक्रिया को अनुचित प्रभाव को रोकने के लिए नियमों की आवश्यकता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The scale of corporate participation in Antalya brings the issue into sharper focus.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अंताल्या में कॉर्पोरेट भागीदारी का पैमाना इस मुद्दे को और अधिक ध्यान में लाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: An analysis by a coalition of non-profits identified 103 major polluter groups with delegations at the summit, including fossil fuel businesses, financiers and companies from other high-emitting sectors.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — गैर-लाभकारी गठबंधन के एक विश्लेषण ने शिखर सम्मेलन में प्रतिनिधिमंडलों के साथ 103 प्रमुख प्रदूषक समूहों की पहचान की, जिनमें जीवाश्म ईंधन व्यवसाय, फाइनेंसर और अन्य उच्च उत्सर्जन क्षेत्रों की कंपनियां शामिल हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: It also identified 30 banks whose fossil fuel financing between 2021 and 2025 amounted to more than $2.2 trillion.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इसने 30 बैंकों की भी पहचान की, जिनका 2021 और 2025 के बीच जीवाश्म ईंधन वित्तपोषण 2.2 ट्रिलियन डॉलर से अधिक था।।

hinglishTracks.en: These are the coalition’s classifications, not official UN figures.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — ये गठबंधन के वर्गीकरण हैं, संयुक्त राष्ट्र के आधिकारिक आंकड़े नहीं।।

hinglishTracks.en: They do not establish that the companies or banks influenced the negotiations.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — वे यह स्थापित नहीं करते कि कंपनियों या बैंकों ने बातचीत को प्रभावित किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: But they show the scale of commercial interests present at a conference whose purpose is to limit global warming.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — लेकिन वे एक सम्मेलन में मौजूद व्यावसायिक हितों के पैमाने को दिखाते हैं जिसका उद्देश्य ग्लोबल वार्मिंग को सीमित करना है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Lien Vandamme of the Center for International Environmental Law says the problem goes beyond the number of corporate participants.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — सेंटर फॉर इंटरनेशनल एनवायर्नमेंटल लॉ के लियन वंदामे का कहना है कि समस्या कॉर्पोरेट प्रतिभागियों की संख्या से परे है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Environmental' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित। इसके Synonyms हैं: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural और Antonyms हैं: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic।

hinglishTracks.en: Although the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) has introduced limited disclosure requirements, she argues that it still lacks a policy to curb corporate influence.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — हालाँकि जलवायु परिवर्तन पर संयुक्त राष्ट्र फ्रेमवर्क कन्वेंशन (यूएनएफसीसीसी) ने सीमित प्रकटीकरण आवश्यकताओं को पेश किया है, उनका तर्क है कि इसमें अभी भी कॉर्पोरेट प्रभाव को रोकने के लिए नीति का अभाव है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “There is currently no policy to curb corporate influence within the UNFCCC process, and this is a fundamental problem,” she says.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — वह कहती हैं, "यूएनएफसीसीसी प्रक्रिया के भीतर कॉर्पोरेट प्रभाव को रोकने के लिए वर्तमान में कोई नीति नहीं है, और यह एक बुनियादी समस्या है।"।

hinglishTracks.en: Once companies gain access, she argues, it becomes extremely difficult to monitor how they use it to influence negotiations.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उनका तर्क है कि एक बार जब कंपनियों को पहुंच मिल जाती है, तो यह निगरानी करना बेहद मुश्किल हो जाता है कि वे बातचीत को प्रभावित करने के लिए इसका उपयोग कैसे करते हैं।।

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #17 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Global climate talks must shut door on fossil fuel ‘clout’

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 10:41:40 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The breakdown in the Antalya summit has deepened the crisis of confidence in climate diplomacy, making transparency and accountability in the negotiating process more urgent than ever.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The failure of the United Nations climate summit in Antalya, Türkiye, to agree on its central political statement, with countries unable to bridge their differences over fossil fuels and other key questions of climate action, has exposed the fragility of international climate cooperation. It should also sharpen scrutiny of who gets access to climate negotiations, whose interests they represent and what safeguards keep decisions accountable to the public. The Türkiye summit ended without agreement on an overarching statement. UN climate chief Simon Stiell said he shared the “deep disappointment” of many that the conference was unable to reach consensus on a statement that typically sends a policy signal to all nations. Some separate negotiating decisions were reached though. Nevertheless, the absence of a political consensus was a serious setback. The breakdown does not show that fossil fuel lobbying caused the impasse. But it does make more urgent a separate question about the credibility of the process. A forum that asks governments to make decisions in the global public interest must be transparent about who is seeking to shape those decisions, what interests they represent and how conflicts are managed. The international climate negotiations that take place every year still lack a comprehensive, enforceable system to identify and manage conflicts of interest involving powerful commercial interests, including fossil fuel companies and state-owned energy businesses. The Antalya conference has underlined why that gap matters. The fossil fuel industry’s record of muddying the waters is well documented. A 2017 study by Geoffrey Supran and Naomi Oreskes compared 187 ExxonMobil communications between 1977 and 2014, including internal documents, scientific publications and paid newspaper advertorials. It found that as the company’s communications became more public, they increasingly expressed doubt about climate science. The researchers concluded that ExxonMobil had contributed to climate science while promoting doubt about it in its advertorials. An industry team discussed a 1998 draft of the Global Climate Science Communications Plan at the American Petroleum Institute’s headquarters. The plan’s stated goal was to persuade a majority of the American public that significant uncertainties remained in climate science and to raise questions among policymakers. This history matters because companies with large investments in oil, gas and coal have a financial stake in how quickly those fuels are phased down, which technologies receive support and how the costs of the transition are distributed. That does not mean every company representative at a climate summit is there to obstruct progress, or that attendance proves influence over a decision. It, however, does mean commercial interests need to be visible and the process needs rules to prevent undue influence. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: Landmines and explosive remnants of war (ERW, meaning unexploded or abandoned ordnance) killed or injured more people in 2025 than in any year since 2020, according to the 28th annual Landmine Monitor report, which was released on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) by the International Campaign to Ban Landmines (ICBL). articles.title: China launches crewed spaceship carrying first Pakistani astronaut to its space station
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Using a Long March-2F rocket, the spacecraft took ‌off at 8:18 a.m. (0018 GMT) ‌from ⁠the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre ⁠in northwest China

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: China on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) launched its Shenzhou-24 crewed spaceship carrying three astronauts , including Pakistan’s Muhammad Zeeshan Ali , the first foreign national to participate in the country’s crewed space programme. The spaceship, atop a Long March-2F carrier rocket, blasted off from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre in northwest China, with officials declaring the launch successful minutes later. The crew comprises mission commander and spacecraft pilot Tang Hongbo, flight engineer Wu Yi and Ali, who will become the first foreign astronaut to visit China’s orbiting Tiangong space station. Mr. Ali will return to Earth aboard the Shenzhou-23 spacecraft after spending about a week in orbit, while Chinese astronauts typically stay at the station for about six months. The spacecraft is expected to dock with the Tiangong space station in a few hours. China built its own space station after it was reportedly excluded from the International Space Station (ISS) over concerns about the involvement of its military, the People’s Liberation Army (PLA), in its space programme. China is currently the only country operating its own space station, which became operational in 2022. Tiangong is relatively small compared to the football pitch-sized ISS, where astronauts from several countries have conducted more than 3,000 experiments since its launch in 1998. NASA plans to retire the ISS in early 2031, using a dedicated deorbit vehicle being developed by SpaceX to guide it into a controlled re-entry over the South Pacific, according to reports.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Shenzhou-24 mission’s main objectives include completing an in-orbit crew rotation with the Shenzhou-23 crew, maintaining routine station operations, conducting scientific research and carrying out maintenance, public outreach and payload tests, Chinese officials said.

Mr. Ali will return to Earth aboard the Shenzhou-23 spacecraft after spending about a week in orbit, while Chinese astronauts typically stay at the station for about six months. The spacecraft is expected to dock with the Tiangong space station in a few hours. China built its own space station after it was reportedly excluded from the International Space Station (ISS) over concerns about the involvement of its military, the People’s Liberation Army (PLA), in its space programme. China is currently the only country operating its own space station, which became operational in 2022. Tiangong is relatively small compared to the football pitch-sized ISS, where astronauts from several countries have conducted more than 3,000 experiments since its launch in 1998. NASA plans to retire the ISS in early 2031, using a dedicated deorbit vehicle being developed by SpaceX to guide it into a controlled re-entry over the South Pacific, according to reports.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Shenzhou-24 mission’s main objectives include completing an in-orbit crew rotation with the Shenzhou-23 crew, maintaining routine station operations, conducting scientific research and carrying out maintenance, public outreach and payload tests, Chinese officials said.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: China on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) launched its Shenzhou-24 crewed spaceship carrying three astronauts , including Pakistan’s Muhammad Zeeshan Ali , the first foreign national to participate in the country’s crewed space programme. The spaceship, atop a Long March-2F carrier rocket, blasted off from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre in northwest China, with officials declaring the launch successful minutes later. The crew comprises mission commander and spacecraft pilot Tang Hongbo, flight engineer Wu Yi and Ali, who will become the first foreign astronaut to visit China’s orbiting Tiangong space station. Mr. Ali will return to Earth aboard the Shenzhou-23 spacecraft after spending about a week in orbit, while Chinese astronauts typically stay at the station for about six months. The spacecraft is expected to dock with the Tiangong space station in a few hours. China built its own space station after it was reportedly excluded from the International Space Station (ISS) over concerns about the involvement of its military, the People’s Liberation Army (PLA), in its space programme. China is currently the only country operating its own space station, which became operational in 2022. Tiangong is relatively small compared to the football pitch-sized ISS, where astronauts from several countries have conducted more than 3,000 experiments since its launch in 1998. NASA plans to retire the ISS in early 2031, using a dedicated deorbit vehicle being developed by SpaceX to guide it into a controlled re-entry over the South Pacific, according to reports.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Shenzhou-24 mission’s main objectives include completing an in-orbit crew rotation with the Shenzhou-23 crew, maintaining routine station operations, conducting scientific research and carrying out maintenance, public outreach and payload tests, Chinese officials said.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Saudi Arabia's Civil Defence said a tower in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District came under what it described as a "terrorist attack" by Houthi militia

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Two Indians were among those injured in an attack on a financial district in Riyadh that triggered strong condemnation from New Delhi. India also denounced continued strikes targeting civilian, economic and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia. “Two Indians are among those injured in the attack on Riyadh financial district. The embassy of India in Riyadh is providing all possible assistance to the injured and their families,” the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said. The attack was carried out on Tuesday (November 24, 2026). Local authorities said the injured included two Saudi citizens, three Nepalese and four Egyptian nationals. The MEA said India strongly condemns the attack in Riyadh as well as the continued strikes targeting civilian, economic and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia. “These attacks seriously endanger civilian lives, violate the sovereignty of Saudi Arabia, and undermine regional security and stability. We call for immediate cessation of such attacks,” it said in a statement. India also reiterated its firm solidarity with the people and government of Saudi Arabia and reaffirmed its unwavering support to the Kingdom in safeguarding its sovereignty and territorial integrity. “We earnestly hope that peace and normalcy will return to the region at the earliest,” the MEA said. There has been a sudden escalation in tensions in West Asia, especially after the Houthis carried out several strikes on Saudi Arabia. The West Asia conflict began in February following attacks on Iran by the U.S. and Israel. New Delhi has consistently called for finding a solution to the conflict through dialogue and diplomacy.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: India has been specifically voicing serious concern over the Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia’s civilian infrastructure and economic assets, cautioning that such strikes undermine regional stability and threaten freedom of navigation through the Bab-el-Mandeb strait.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #23 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 At least two Indians among 11 injured in Houthi attack in Riyadh; New Delhi condemns strike

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 11:28:03 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Saudi Arabia's Civil Defence said a tower in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District came under what it described as a "terrorist attack" by Houthi militia

India also denounced continued strikes targeting civilian, economic and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia. “Two Indians are among those injured in the attack on Riyadh financial district. The embassy of India in Riyadh is providing all possible assistance to the injured and their families,” the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said. The attack was carried out on Tuesday (November 24, 2026). Local authorities said the injured included two Saudi citizens, three Nepalese and four Egyptian nationals. The MEA said India strongly condemns the attack in Riyadh as well as the continued strikes targeting civilian, economic and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia. “These attacks seriously endanger civilian lives, violate the sovereignty of Saudi Arabia, and undermine regional security and stability. We call for immediate cessation of such attacks,” it said in a statement. India also reiterated its firm solidarity with the people and government of Saudi Arabia and reaffirmed its unwavering support to the Kingdom in safeguarding its sovereignty and territorial integrity. “We earnestly hope that peace and normalcy will return to the region at the earliest,” the MEA said. There has been a sudden escalation in tensions in West Asia, especially after the Houthis carried out several strikes on Saudi Arabia. The West Asia conflict began in February following attacks on Iran by the U.S. and Israel. New Delhi has consistently called for finding a solution to the conflict through dialogue and diplomacy.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: India has been specifically voicing serious concern over the Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia’s civilian infrastructure and economic assets, cautioning that such strikes undermine regional stability and threaten freedom of navigation through the Bab-el-Mandeb strait.

articles.title: Over 6,500 lung cancer cases reported in prominent Delhi hospitals in six years; one death every three days
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A request was also made for data on patients who had never smoked. However, none of the institutes provided any data on it

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Around 83 cases of lung cancer were recorded every month across prominent government hospitals in the national capital in the last six and a half year period, with one patient succumbing to the disease every three days. This information was provided in response to an RTI query to AIIMS, RML Hospital, Safdarjung Hospital and the Delhi State Cancer Institute. Under the Right to Information (RTI) Act, data regarding lung cancer cases and associated deaths between January 1, 2020, and July 31, 2026, were requested from the hospitals. Safdarjung Hospital only provided the number of lung cancer deaths but did not disclose the total number of cases. A request was also made for data on patients who had never smoked. However, none of the institutes provided any data on it. According to information provided in response to separate RTI applications filed by PTI Bhasha, 6,581 lung cancer cases were recorded across three of the four hospitals (excluding Safdarjung), averaging 83 cases per month. Across all four hospitals, 913 deaths were reported, which translates to one patient dying every three days. The national capital is currently grappling with a severe air pollution crisis, an annual affair now in November, which is observed as the Lung Cancer Awareness Month. Although health experts state that long-term exposure to air pollution increases the risk of lung cancer, it is not the sole cause. Smoking and genetic mutations are two of the other contributing factors. The highest number of cases was recorded at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS). This central government hospital provided data for the period from January 2020 to March 2026, during which 4,860 cases of lung cancer were registered and 158 deaths occurred. This averages to approximately 65 cases per month, with two patient deaths occurring monthly. According to data from the Delhi State Cancer Institute (DSCI), 1,613 cases of lung cancer were reported between January 1, 2020, and July 2026, resulting in 354 deaths. This translates to an average of 20 cases per month, with four patient deaths occurring monthly during this period.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The institute noted that in 2021, the disease was also diagnosed in two children, and over a span of about six and a half years, 351 women were found to be suffering from lung cancer. However, it did not provide a gender-segregated breakdown of the deaths.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #25 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Over 6,500 lung cancer cases reported in prominent Delhi hospitals in six years; one death every three days

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 11:51:20 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A request was also made for data on patients who had never smoked. However, none of the institutes provided any data on it

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Around 83 cases of lung cancer were recorded every month across prominent government hospitals in the national capital in the last six and a half year period, with one patient succumbing to the disease every three days. This information was provided in response to an RTI query to AIIMS, RML Hospital, Safdarjung Hospital and the Delhi State Cancer Institute. Under the Right to Information (RTI) Act, data regarding lung cancer cases and associated deaths between January 1, 2020, and July 31, 2026, were requested from the hospitals. Safdarjung Hospital only provided the number of lung cancer deaths but did not disclose the total number of cases. A request was also made for data on patients who had never smoked. However, none of the institutes provided any data on it. According to information provided in response to separate RTI applications filed by PTI Bhasha, 6,581 lung cancer cases were recorded across three of the four hospitals (excluding Safdarjung), averaging 83 cases per month. Across all four hospitals, 913 deaths were reported, which translates to one patient dying every three days. The national capital is currently grappling with a severe air pollution crisis, an annual affair now in November, which is observed as the Lung Cancer Awareness Month. Although health experts state that long-term exposure to air pollution increases the risk of lung cancer, it is not the sole cause. Smoking and genetic mutations are two of the other contributing factors. The highest number of cases was recorded at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS). This central government hospital provided data for the period from January 2020 to March 2026, during which 4,860 cases of lung cancer were registered and 158 deaths occurred. This averages to approximately 65 cases per month, with two patient deaths occurring monthly. According to data from the Delhi State Cancer Institute (DSCI), 1,613 cases of lung cancer were reported between January 1, 2020, and July 2026, resulting in 354 deaths. This translates to an average of 20 cases per month, with four patient deaths occurring monthly during this period.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The institute noted that in 2021, the disease was also diagnosed in two children, and over a span of about six and a half years, 351 women were found to be suffering from lung cancer. However, it did not provide a gender-segregated breakdown of the deaths.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Information (Adjective / Verb)
जानकारी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Information' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Pollution (Noun)
प्रदूषण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Pollution' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Hospital (Adjective)
अस्पताल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Hospital' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Over 6,500 lung cancer cases reported in prominent Delhi hospitals in six years; one death every three days", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. A request was also made for data on patients who had never smoked.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Over 6,500 lung cancer cases reported in promine' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Over 6,500 lung cancer cases reported in prom' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Over 6,500 lung cancer cases reported in prom' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "A request was also made for data on patients who had never smoked." (Hinglish Arth: उन रोगियों के डेटा के लिए भी अनुरोध किया गया था जिन्होंने कभी धूम्रपान नहीं किया था।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Over 6,500 lung cancer cases reported in prominent Delhi hospitals in six years; one death every three days"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. However, it did not provide a gender-segregated breakdown of the deaths.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "However, it did not provide a gender-segregated breakdown of the deaths." (Hinglish Arth: हालाँकि, इसने मौतों का लिंग-पृथक विवरण प्रदान नहीं किया।)

articles.title: India warns against using tech for strategic one-upmanship, calls for inclusive AI governance
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: India’s UN Ambassador asserted that amid the rapid integration of AI into military and intelligence spheres, responsibility for the use of lethal autonomous weapons systems must always rest with humans

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India has voiced concern over the instrumentalisation of technology for strategic one-upmanship through export control and licensing regimes, calling out the tendency to treat countries of the Global South as mere consumers as it underscored that technological transformation must not deepen existing inequalities. Addressing the Security Council’s high-level open debate on Maintenance of International Peace and Security on ‘Conflict Resolution in an Era of Rapid Technological Change’, India’s Permanent Representative to the UN Ambassador Harish Parvathaneni said AI systems can inadvertently perpetuate biases related to gender, language and socio-economic background. Delivered India's statement at the UN Security Council high-level open debate convened by Latvia. Speaking on the theme, "Conflict Resolution in an Era of Rapid Technological Change", I highlighted four key considerations: 1️⃣ Technology must remain human-centric and an instrument of peace 2️⃣ The application of emerging technologies in conflict settings must be responsible, human-centric, respect sovereignty, and adhere to international law 3️⃣ We must address threats posed by misuse of emerging technologies such as AI 4️⃣ Technological transformation must not deepen existing inequalities. We must address technology denial and the instrumentalisation of technology for strategic one-upmanship through export control and licensing regimes. Countries of the Global South should not be tested as mere consumers without any agency or stake in how emerging technologies such as AI are developed, regulated and deployed. “We note with concern the emerging medium- and long-term trends of technology denial and the instrumentalisation of technology for strategic one-upmanship through export control and licensing regimes, and a tendency to treat countries of the Global South as mere consumers without any agency or stake in how emerging technologies such as AI are developed, are regulated and are deployed,” Mr. Parvathaneni said. “AI must not reduce human beings to mere data points or raw material. India supports inclusive international cooperation on technology governance, including through the United Nations, with due regard to national priorities and developmental needs,” he said. He emphasised that technology should serve humanity, strengthen international cooperation, and advance the cause of lasting peace. “Technology may inform human judgement but cannot and should not replace it,” he said. India also asserted that amid the rapid integration of artificial intelligence into military and intelligence spheres, responsibility for use of lethal autonomous weapons systems must always rest with humans. “Rapid technological advances are fundamentally transforming the nature of conflict and the international security landscape. Artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, and emerging digital technologies present unprecedented opportunities but also introduce new vulnerabilities and risks across the entire conflict cycle,” Mr. Parvathaneni said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He added that the rapid integration of artificial intelligence into military, intelligence, and civilian spheres has fundamentally transformed the landscape of international peace and security.

(Hinglish Arth: उन्होंने कहा कि सैन्य, खुफिया और नागरिक क्षेत्रों में कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता के तेजी से एकीकरण ने अंतरराष्ट्रीय शांति और सुरक्षा के परिदृश्य को मौलिक रूप से बदल दिया है।)

hinglishTracks.en: India’s UN Ambassador asserted that amid the rapid integration of AI into military and intelligence spheres, responsibility for the use of lethal autonomous weapons systems must always rest with humans
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — भारत के संयुक्त राष्ट्र राजदूत ने जोर देकर कहा कि सैन्य और खुफिया क्षेत्रों में एआई के तेजी से एकीकरण के बीच, घातक स्वायत्त हथियार प्रणालियों के उपयोग की जिम्मेदारी हमेशा मनुष्यों की होनी चाहिए। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Responsibility' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: ज़िम्मेदारी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Responsibility' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: India has voiced concern over the instrumentalisation of technology for strategic one-upmanship through export control and licensing regimes, calling out the tendency to treat countries of the Global South as mere consumers as it underscored that technological transformation must not deepen existing inequalities.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — भारत ने निर्यात नियंत्रण और लाइसेंसिंग व्यवस्थाओं के माध्यम से रणनीतिक वन-अपमैनशिप के लिए प्रौद्योगिकी के उपकरणीकरण पर चिंता व्यक्त की है, और वैश्विक दक्षिण के देशों को केवल उपभोक्ताओं के रूप में मानने की प्रवृत्ति का आह्वान किया है क्योंकि यह रेखांकित किया गया है कि तकनीकी परिवर्तन से मौजूदा असमानताएं गहरी नहीं होनी चाहिए।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Transformation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: परिवर्तन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Transformation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Addressing the Security Council’s high-level open debate on Maintenance of International Peace and Security on ‘Conflict Resolution in an Era of Rapid Technological Change’, India’s Permanent Representative to the UN Ambassador Harish Parvathaneni said AI systems can inadvertently perpetuate biases related to gender, language and socio-economic background.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 'तीव्र तकनीकी परिवर्तन के युग में संघर्ष समाधान' पर अंतर्राष्ट्रीय शांति और सुरक्षा के रखरखाव पर सुरक्षा परिषद की उच्च स्तरीय खुली बहस को संबोधित करते हुए, संयुक्त राष्ट्र में भारत के स्थायी प्रतिनिधि हरीश पर्वतनेनी ने कहा कि एआई सिस्टम अनजाने में लिंग, भाषा और सामाजिक-आर्थिक पृष्ठभूमि से संबंधित पूर्वाग्रहों को कायम रख सकते हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Representative' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रतिनिधि — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Representative' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Delivered India's statement at the UN Security Council high-level open debate convened by Latvia.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — लातविया द्वारा बुलाई गई संयुक्त राष्ट्र सुरक्षा परिषद की उच्च स्तरीय खुली बहस में भारत का वक्तव्य दिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Speaking on the theme, "Conflict Resolution in an Era of Rapid Technological Change", I highlighted four key considerations: 1️⃣ Technology must remain human-centric and an instrument of peace 2️⃣ The application of emerging technologies in conflict settings must be responsible, human-centric, respect sovereignty, and adhere to international law 3️⃣ We must address threats posed by misuse of emerging technologies such as AI 4️⃣ Technological transformation must not deepen existing inequalities.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — "तीव्र तकनीकी परिवर्तन के युग में संघर्ष समाधान" विषय पर बोलते हुए, मैंने चार प्रमुख विचारों पर प्रकाश डाला: 1️⃣ प्रौद्योगिकी को मानव-केंद्रित और शांति का साधन रहना चाहिए 2️⃣ संघर्ष स्थितियों में उभरती प्रौद्योगिकियों का अनुप्रयोग जिम्मेदार, मानव-केंद्रित होना चाहिए, संप्रभुता का सम्मान करना चाहिए और अंतरराष्ट्रीय कानून का पालन करना चाहिए 3️⃣ हमें एआई जैसी उभरती प्रौद्योगिकियों के दुरुपयोग से उत्पन्न खतरों का समाधान करना चाहिए 4️⃣ तकनीकी परिवर्तन। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Responsibility' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: ज़िम्मेदारी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Responsibility' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: We must address technology denial and the instrumentalisation of technology for strategic one-upmanship through export control and licensing regimes.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हमें निर्यात नियंत्रण और लाइसेंसिंग व्यवस्थाओं के माध्यम से रणनीतिक एक-अपमैनशिप के लिए प्रौद्योगिकी इनकार और प्रौद्योगिकी के उपकरणीकरण को संबोधित करना चाहिए।।

hinglishTracks.en: Countries of the Global South should not be tested as mere consumers without any agency or stake in how emerging technologies such as AI are developed, regulated and deployed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — ग्लोबल साउथ के देशों को एआई जैसी उभरती प्रौद्योगिकियों को कैसे विकसित, विनियमित और तैनात किया जाता है, इसमें किसी एजेंसी या हिस्सेदारी के बिना केवल उपभोक्ताओं के रूप में परीक्षण नहीं किया जाना चाहिए।।

hinglishTracks.en: “We note with concern the emerging medium- and long-term trends of technology denial and the instrumentalisation of technology for strategic one-upmanship through export control and licensing regimes, and a tendency to treat countries of the Global South as mere consumers without any agency or stake in how emerging technologies such as AI are developed, are regulated and are deployed,” Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — “हम चिंता के साथ प्रौद्योगिकी इनकार के उभरते मध्यम और दीर्घकालिक रुझानों और निर्यात नियंत्रण और लाइसेंसिंग व्यवस्थाओं के माध्यम से रणनीतिक एक-अपमैनशिप के लिए प्रौद्योगिकी के उपकरणीकरण, और ग्लोबल साउथ के देशों को बिना किसी एजेंसी या हिस्सेदारी के मात्र उपभोक्ताओं के रूप में मानने की प्रवृत्ति पर ध्यान देते हैं कि एआई जैसी उभरती प्रौद्योगिकियों को कैसे विकसित किया जाता है, विनियमित किया जाता है और तैनात किया जाता है,” श्रीमान।।

hinglishTracks.en: Parvathaneni said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — पार्वथनेनी ने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: “AI must not reduce human beings to mere data points or raw material.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — “एआई को इंसानों को केवल डेटा पॉइंट या कच्चे माल तक सीमित नहीं करना चाहिए।।

hinglishTracks.en: India supports inclusive international cooperation on technology governance, including through the United Nations, with due regard to national priorities and developmental needs,” he said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — भारत राष्ट्रीय प्राथमिकताओं और विकास संबंधी जरूरतों को ध्यान में रखते हुए संयुक्त राष्ट्र सहित प्रौद्योगिकी प्रशासन पर समावेशी अंतरराष्ट्रीय सहयोग का समर्थन करता है।''। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inclusive' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: समावेशी — जिसमें समाज के हर वर्ग (खासकर गरीब और वंचित वर्ग) को बराबर शामिल किया जाए। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Egalitarian, All-encompassing और Antonyms हैं: Exclusive, Discriminatory, Narrow।

hinglishTracks.en: He emphasised that technology should serve humanity, strengthen international cooperation, and advance the cause of lasting peace.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — उन्होंने इस बात पर जोर दिया कि प्रौद्योगिकी को मानवता की सेवा करनी चाहिए, अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सहयोग को मजबूत करना चाहिए और स्थायी शांति के उद्देश्य को आगे बढ़ाना चाहिए।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Technology may inform human judgement but cannot and should not replace it,” he said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — उन्होंने कहा, "प्रौद्योगिकी मानव निर्णय को सूचित कर सकती है लेकिन इसे प्रतिस्थापित नहीं कर सकती और न ही करना चाहिए।"।

hinglishTracks.en: India also asserted that amid the rapid integration of artificial intelligence into military and intelligence spheres, responsibility for use of lethal autonomous weapons systems must always rest with humans.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — भारत ने यह भी कहा कि सैन्य और खुफिया क्षेत्रों में कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता के तेजी से एकीकरण के बीच, घातक स्वायत्त हथियार प्रणालियों के उपयोग की जिम्मेदारी हमेशा मनुष्यों की होनी चाहिए।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Responsibility' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: ज़िम्मेदारी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Responsibility' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: “Rapid technological advances are fundamentally transforming the nature of conflict and the international security landscape.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — “तीव्र तकनीकी प्रगति मूल रूप से संघर्ष की प्रकृति और अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा परिदृश्य को बदल रही है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Transformation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: परिवर्तन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Transformation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, and emerging digital technologies present unprecedented opportunities but also introduce new vulnerabilities and risks across the entire conflict cycle,” Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता, स्वायत्त प्रणालियाँ और उभरती डिजिटल प्रौद्योगिकियाँ अभूतपूर्व अवसर प्रस्तुत करती हैं, लेकिन पूरे संघर्ष चक्र में नई कमजोरियाँ और जोखिम भी पेश करती हैं,'' श्री।

hinglishTracks.en: Parvathaneni said.
